3. Public Forum

4. Work Session: Syringe Litter Report 
• The CDNR committee met to review and update recommendations 
from their syringe litter report. They discussed the need for regular updates 
from the Board of Health on the impact of new disposal boxes and explored 
ways to support community-led cleanup efforts. The committee considered 
the feasibility of involving the Community Justice Center in cleanup 
initiatives and acknowledged the work of the Safe Outdoor Sites group. 
They debated the scope of their recommendations, particularly regarding 
enforcement of drug dealing and oversight of SSPs, and decided to seek 
more information from the Department of Health and Vermont Cares. The 
meeting also touched on the integration of SSPs with the Overdose 
Prevention Center and the importance of transparency in reporting syringe 
distribution and collection data.
